name: hypr
title: Hypr
description: Inspect Hyprland monitors, workspaces, windows, layers and keybinds, switch workspace layouts, and apply animation, border and shader presets.
author: black

commands.name: monitors
commands.title: Monitors
commands.subtitle: Show Hyprland monitors
commands.description: Display active and inactive Hyprland monitors.

commands.name: switch-layout
commands.title: Switch Layout
commands.subtitle: Switch layout for active workspace
commands.description: Switch the tiling layout for the active Hyprland workspace.

commands.name: animations
commands.title: Animations
commands.subtitle: Apply animation presets
commands.description: Browse and apply Hyprland animation presets, including your own files.

commands.name: borders
commands.title: Borders
commands.subtitle: Apply border presets
commands.description: Browse and apply Hyprland window border presets, including your own files.

commands.name: shaders
commands.title: Shaders
commands.subtitle: Apply screen shader presets
commands.description: Browse and apply Hyprland screen shader presets, including your own files.

preferences.name: borderSize
preferences.title: Border Size
preferences.description: Thickness in pixels applied to every border preset, overriding the size in the preset file.

preferences.name: tintRole
preferences.title: Tint Color
preferences.description: Palette role the Follow Colors Tint shader blends into the screen.

preferences.name: duotoneShadows
preferences.title: Duotone Shadows
preferences.description: Palette role the Duotone shader uses for dark areas; it is scaled down so black stays black.

preferences.name: duotoneHighlights
preferences.title: Duotone Highlights
preferences.description: Palette role the Duotone shader uses for bright areas.

preferences.name: colorblindType
preferences.title: Color Blind Type
preferences.description: Colour vision deficiency the Color Blind Correction shader compensates for.
